title: 🔊🎤 Live Attenuation — Sound in the Physical Plane
description: Bacteria release signaling molecules (autoinducers) into the environment. When the concentration exceeds a threshold, gene expression changes. Gaia does the same: she speaks (TV), the sound attenuates through the room, the mic (grapheneGate) hears the attenuated signal, and she processes the feedback. The physical room IS the medium.

4_sense.action: ADB audio capture from phone mic

6_respond.action: New TTS based on what was heard

quorum_sensing_parameters.note: When Gaia hears herself clearly (above threshold), she knows the room is listening. When attenuated below threshold, she knows she's alone.

provenance_trio_role.loamSpine: Records each speak-hear cycle as an append-only spine entry. Provenance chain.
provenance_trio_role.rhizoCrypt: Encrypts and stores the raw audio DAG. Content-addressed by BLAKE3 hash.
provenance_trio_role.sweetGrass: Extracts semantic meaning. Attributes knowledge. Builds the knowledge graph.

hud_visualization.display: Three concentric rings: inner=brain, middle=room, outer=world
